title: Customer replies while the agent is offline (not on vacation) ? case reopens with the SAME agent | APPR | Controllable (Code 96 � Operations Control) | Delay 6 to under 9 hrs | 1 Pax | 1 Leg | Basic Aeroplan
description:
Checks that a parked eligible case stays with its owner when the customer replies while that agent is signed out. Flight AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late (Code 96, Controllable). DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02, CAD 700. The customer leaves the chat before payment. Agent Sarah Martin sends "Action Required" with the secure payment link and parks the case. On day 9 Sarah signs out at the end of her shift. Her profile is NOT set to On Leave. That evening the customer replies within the 30-day window. The system must move the case to "Update Pending Action" in Sarah's Assigned Cases list with the "?? UPDATE RECEIVED" tag. It must NOT send the case to "To Be Assigned" or let another agent pull it. When Sarah logs back in the next morning she opens the case (In Progress) and the customer completes payout. The customer lives in Canada and picks Cash, so payment goes by Interac and only the email is collected.

Prerequisites:
PNR: PK005 � single passenger �milie Pelletier (Adult, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing). AC 412 YUL ? YYZ, July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual 19:00 (7h delay). Code 96 (Operations Control � Controllable). Travelled, arrived late. No VOL/INVOL changes. AC only. Claim filed Jul 28, 2026. No duplicate. CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Owner agent: Sarah Martin (CR agent, active profile, NOT On Leave). Second agent: Marc Dubois (Available, same queue). Park date: Aug 1, 2026. Sarah signs out: Aug 10, 18:00. Customer reply: Aug 10, 21:00 (day 9, within 30 days). Sarah signs in: Aug 11, 09:00.
